## Statements

- Stated by harness (dsh-readme, Developer preview): dsh is a developer preview and its maintainers expect compatibility-breaking changes; recheck flags and config after each upgrade.
- Stated by harness (dsh-providers, Reasoning effort): A model added by hand offers no effort control until its reasoning levels are declared in the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
- Stated by harness (dsh-providers, Request compatibility): Behind an OpenAI-compatible gateway, dsh may need compat switches such as supportsDeveloperRole false and maxTokensField max_tokens, or the gateway refuses requests.
- Stated by harness (dsh-providers, Image input): Custom-provider models are text-only unless their input list names image; declaring it does not verify the endpoint serves images.
- Stated by harness (dsh-providers, Troubleshooting, fetching available models): Model discovery calls GET /models and can fail on some gateways; add model ids by hand when it returns nothing.
